lead: An array subscript keyed by `bytes` or by a `string|int` union is an ICE in `nvs-ir`, not a diagnostic.
body: `lower_array_key` has arms for `Str`, `Int` and `Uint` only, so `$seen[$k] = true;` over a `string|int $k` the checker admitted panics ("an array key lowered to …"). Write `$seen[$k as string]`, the spelling key normalization maps an integer onto; the fix proper is a `nvs-types` diagnostic.
